name: io.github.tonyyang0504/mirakl-mcp
description: Mirakl-powered marketplaces (ecommerce channels): me, list_orders, mark_shipped. Every tool maps to

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_MIRAKL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Shop API key generated in the marketplace's Mirakl seller back office (user menu > API key > Generate); sent verbatim as the Authorization header (no Bearer prefix).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_MIRAKL_INSTANCE_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Host of your marketplace's Mirakl instance without scheme, e.g. marketplace.example.com or <operator>.mirakl.net (the operator gives it with the API key); every call goes to https://<instance_host>/api/...

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_MIRAKL_SHOP_ID
environmentVariables.description: Numeric shop id, only when your API key's user has access to several shops (sent as ?shop_id= on every call; the default shop is used otherwise).
